title.narrative: Yara Fertilizers Philippines - Installation of Solar-Powered Water Pump in Calapan, Oriental Mindoro

description.narrative: The project installs solar-powered water pumps for agricultural irrigation. Areas covered are around the Santa Cruz, Calapan, Oriental Mindoro that are not serviced by the national irrigation system. The project aids requirements during the critical production days of rice cultivation. The technology improves production, lowers costs, and supports the farmers' cooperative.
